programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Don Vizioso veut prendre le contrôle de la ville. Pour cela, il doit se débarrasser des mutants présents dans la ville de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey, Leo et Raph se disputent au sujet de leur BD préférée. Pour Mikey, Bat-Boulon et Écrou Kid sont au-dessus du panier. Leo préfère l'Homme-araignée, Supérieur-Man, ou encore l'Invincible Bossu. Pour Raph, il n'y a pas photo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder absorbe du mutagène et devient Super Shredder. Il capture Karai pour attirer Splinter dans un piège et en finir avec son ennemi juré. Mais Splinter lit clair dans son jeu et le piège à son tour.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tandis que Donnie et Mikey partent explorer le gouffre à la recherche de Splinter, Leo, April et Karai affrontent Super Shredder. Karaï trouve son point faible : son cœur protubérant. Mais le méchant s'échappe à temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: The Legend of Korra
programme.desc: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Katara and Sokka, a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe, discover a twelve-year-old boy frozen in an iceberg. Katara wonders if this boy is the Avatar whom the world has been awaiting for a hundred years.
programme.sub-title: The Boy in the Iceberg (The Avatar Returns Part 1)

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao’s Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn’t a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Zhao’s invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe’s defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help – but will he return in time to stop Zhao and prevent the destruction of the Water Tribe?
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids become lost in the treacherous "Cave of Two Lovers."

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony seeks to challenge his notions of Mississippi by taking a road trip to meet a cast of Mississippians enjoying the diverse foodways and embracing the traditional and contemporary music worlds.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony visits Andalucia during Semana Santa – Holy Week – a time filled with great pageantry and excitement. Tony’s longtime DP, Zach Zamboni, currently lives in Granada with his fiancée, Fuen Sanchez.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The two funniest and most brilliant chef/restaurateurs in Canada, Joe Beef's Dave McMillan and Fred Morin, take Tony across Canada by rail.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Un jour, la présidente des États-Unis se retrouve face à un choix impossible : elle apprend que des terroristes ont pris le contrôle d'un avion dans lequel voyage son frère!

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 7
programme.desc: Marc a donc épousé Isa. Hélène tente de faire bonne figure, mais intérieurement elle est brisée. Christian essaie d'oublier son amour impossible pour Isa dans les bras d'Audrey.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 8
programme.desc: Le diagnostic est tombé : Marc restera totalement paralysé à vie. Surmontant sa peine, Isa s'installe près de lui à l'hôpital et s'en occupe nuit et jour. Même Hélène l'admire et pourtant elle la hait viscéralement.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 9
programme.desc: Traumatisée par la mort de Marc, Isa a perdu l'enfant qu'elle attendait de lui. Elle était décidée à refuser l'héritage, mais comme Hélène agit d'une manière ignoble avec elle, elle change d'avis.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 10
programme.desc: Le résultat de l'autopsie tombe : Marc a été empoisonné. La Juge est intimement convaincue qu'Isa a aidé son mari à mourir mais doit le prouver. Elle interroge scrupuleusement tout son entourage et dresse un portrait psychologique de la suspecte...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 11
programme.desc: Isa a été inculpée et mise en prison. Elle refuse de prendre un avocat pour se défendre malgré l'insistance de Christian et Patricia qui lui rendent souvent visite.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 12
programme.desc: Le jour du procès d'Isa approche. Arnaud, qui ignore encore qu'Isa est sa fille, pousse Geneviève à lui rendre visite en prison avec Tanguy. La mère et la fille sont bouleversées de se retrouver. Elles font la paix...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 13
programme.desc: Isa a en possession la lettre qui accuse Hélène d’avoir été l’instigatrice de la mort de Marc. Plus rien ne peut arrêter son ascension. Elle efface un passé douloureux en rejetant son oncle Marcel taraudé par le remords de l’avoir violée.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 14
programme.desc: Audrey, délaissée par Christian, s'ennuie de plus en plus à La Réserve. Elle ne veut pas reprendre le chant. De son côté, Sylvain fait tout pour reconquérir Isa.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 15
programme.desc: Hélène a désormais tous les moyens pour se venger d'Isa, mais elle est totalement dépendante physiquement de Sylvain.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 16
programme.desc: Christian qui s’est marié par désespoir révèle ses véritables sentiments à Isa qui reste sourde à ses avances. Hélène de son côté, est tombée sous la coupe de Sylvain qui se joue d’elle...

programme.title: Aventures Caraïbes: Lune de miel
programme.desc: Désormais mariés après avoir surmonté tous les dangers, Linda et Lucas délaissent les Antilles pour savourer leur bonheur sur les plages de la Colombie.

programme.title: Aventures Caraïbes: Rêves ou mensonges
programme.desc: Linda fait la connaissance de Tanya. Elle est surprise d'apprendre que la jeune femme est agent secret et a été mariée à Lucas...

programme.title: Aventures Caraïbes: Deux filles au soleil
programme.desc: Linda ne se résigne pas à admettre que l'union passagère des deux ex-agents secrets n'était motivée que par des raisons professionnelles. Elle ne dissimule pas son hostilité envers cette cohabitation.

programme.title: Aventures Caraïbes: Au cœur de la jungle
programme.desc: Depuis le début, l'ombre de Huerta plane au-dessus des deux baroudeuses. Chantages, meurtres... Cet homme brutal et manipulateur ne recule devant rien pour parvenir à ses fins.

programme.title: Cœur Caraïbes: Madinina, l'île aux fleurs
programme.desc: Linda, top model à la carrière prometteuse, mène une vie trépidante rythmée par les défilés, les castings et les séances de photos.

programme.sub-title: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Prima Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Seconda Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: Fata Morgana
programme.desc: La dottoressa Magnus, sua figlia Ashley e il dottor Will Zimmerman liberano tre donne da una misteriosa cripta in Scozia, riportandole al Santuario per trovare rifugio. All'insaputa della squadra, e delle donne stesse, loro hanno poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'uomo Flessibile
programme.desc: Un'indagine su una serie di bizzarre rapine porta Magnus e Will a una banda criminale di ladri che sembrano essere in grado di intrufolarsi tra le crepe della legge... letteralmente.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kush
programme.desc: Di ritorno con un anormale catturato in Himalaya, Magnus e Will sono isolati dalla civiltà dopo che il loro aereo precipita in una catena montuosa Mentre aspettano una squadra di soccorso, i sopravvissuti cominciano a essere vittime di attacchi.

programme.title: Sanctuary: I Nubbini
programme.desc: Quando una coppia di anormali carini, pelosi e apparentemente innocui viene portata per uno studio scientifico, la squadra del Santuario inizia a mostrare alcune attrazioni animali nascoste l'una per l'altra.

programme.title: Sanctuary: I Cinque
programme.desc: Durante una riunione segreta a Roma, Magnus incontra Nikola Tesla, che le confida che la Cabala è venuta a vendicarsi. Magnus si accorge che la lealtà di Tesla potrebbe non essere così salda come quando facevano parte di un ordine chiamato I Cinque.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Edward
programme.desc: Un artista con una grande capacità di disegnare immagini a memoria può essere la chiave per risolvere la morte sospetta di suo padre violento Ma ci vorrà il profilo forense di Will per determinare se i disegni del ragazzo sono ispirati alla realtà.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Requiem
programme.desc: Magnus e Will indagano su un'angosciante richiesta d'aiuto nelle profondità del Triangolo delle Bermuda, dando origine a una battaglia mortale per salvare la vita di Magnus.

programme.title: Sanctuary: I Guerrieri
programme.desc: Indagando sulla scomparsa di un vecchio amico del college, Will si ritrova coinvolto in un fight club sotterraneo dove i combattenti sono anormali geneticamente modificati che combattono fino alla morte come gladiatori dei giorni nostri.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Mai Fidarsi
programme.desc: Magnus e la squadra del Santuario tentano di catturare una creatura rara e mortale - il tutto sotto l'occhio vigile di una troupe di un TG locale.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Rivelazione Prima Parte
programme.desc: Gli anormali in regioni remote sono sottoposti a un agente biologico aereo che li costringe a lanciare una violenta serie di omicidi. Riconoscendo il lavoro della Cabala, Magnus e Druitt riuniscono i Cinque per la prima volta in oltre un secolo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Rivelazione Seconda Parte
programme.desc: I Cinque, guidati da Magnus, tentano di trovare il labirinto segreto nella città decimata di Bhalasaam. Una volta trovato, devono completare una serie di

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Sangue Della Stripe Prima Parte
programme.desc: In una disperata ricerca per trovare sua figlia, Magnus ottiene dei file top secret che le danno indizi sul catastrofico piano della Cabala per la Rete dei Santuari...e sul ruolo devastante di Ashley in esso.
programme.sub-title: Il Sangue Della Stripe Prima Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Sangue Della Stripe Seconda Parte
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus va testa a testa con la Cabala e deve fare la scelta definitiva...salvare sua figlia, o rischiare la sopravvivenza dell'intera Rete dei Santuari.
programme.sub-title: Il Sangue Della Stripe Seconda Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'elogio Funebre
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus lotta per trovare una chiusura dopo la distruzione di molti Santuari in tutto il mondo, mentre la squadra si prepara ad elaborare e ospitare centinaia di anormali espropriati che cercano rifugio nel Santuario di Magnus.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Supereroe
programme.desc: La dottoressa Magnus indaga su un improbabile "supereroe" che è intento a contrastare il crimine in città. Ma le sue buone azioni stanno interferendo con il lavoro del Santuario e minacciando involontariamente le vite di persone innocenti ovunque.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Notte Della Terra
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus si sveglia per trovare il Santuario in rovina e l'intera città decimata, senza alcun ricordo di come sia avvenuta la devastazione.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Mostro In Noi
programme.desc: La dott.ssa Magnus lotta per salvare la vita di uno dei ricercatori del Santuario che è stato attaccato da un Anormale addomesticato. Henry cerca di capire cosa, o chi, abbia causato la reazione così violenta dell'Anormale.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Triade
programme.desc: Will si mette contro i capi della Rete dei Santuari per difendere Magnus che è accusata di un omicidio. Ma mentre le prove si accumulano contro di lei, anche Will ha difficoltà a trovare un modo per difendere in modo convincente la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex begin their chilling investigation at the historic Clifton Hall Masonic Temple. Hidden behind closed doors for over a century, this sacred space holds more than just ritual secrets. They explore the eerie corridors and lodge rooms.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The investigation continues as Bex and Sean split up to face the darkness alone inside Clifton Hall. From intelligent knocking and voices to the chilling sound of a child and unseen footsteps on the carpet.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In a church reborn as a gym, something old still lingers in the shadows. Sean and Bex investigate Dream Body Gym inside the former Manor Church — where whispers echo through stairwells, music box melodies drift through empty rooms.
programme.sub-title: Haunted Strength – The Church Gym Investigation

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse — and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the first of a five-part investigation inside the historic Greenfield Valley Heritage Park, the team explores the eerie ruins of the old mills. Known for reports of ghostly children, unexplained footsteps, and phantom knocks on stone walls.
programme.sub-title: Greenfield Valley: Echoes of the Mill : Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: As the team delves deeper into the Valley Mills, subtle sounds begin to stir the silence—unheard by the cameras, but felt by those present. A chilling metallic swing echoes through the empty building with no visible source.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In this chilling third part of our Greenfield Valley investigation, we continue deep within the historic mills—where echoes of the past seem to come alive. With intense K2 meter spikes, disembodied footsteps and unexplained sounds.
programme.sub-title: Whispers of the Forgotten – Greenfield Valley: Part 3

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the historic heart of Greenfield Valley Mills, Sean and Bex uncover chilling echoes of its industrial past. Once alive with the hum of machinery and the toil of mill workers, the site now stands in eerie silence.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In this chilling investigation, the Ghost Dimension team travel deep into Greenfield Valley to uncover the haunted secrets of Basingwerk Abbey. Once home to Cistercian monks and steeped in centuries of devotion and conflict.
programme.sub-title: Echoes of the Abbey: Hauntings at Greenfield Valley: Part 5

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Lady in Grey
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate claims of a ghost lady in grey haunting Windleshaw abbey, St Helens, Merseyside. Over 600 years old and with new paranormal encounters reported almost weekly. Bex and Sean attempt to make contact with the infamous lady in grey.

programme.title: Ghost Dimensions Top 10 Scariest Moments
programme.desc: A special look into the top 10 of Ghost Dimension’s scariest moments. Venturing into the UK’s most haunted buildings, we take a look back at the scariest captures.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fort Crosby
programme.desc: Crosby Battery, also known as Crosby Point Battery and Fort Crosby, was an artillery battery situated between Crosby and Hightown in Lancashire, United Kingdom. The battery was used for port defence and anti-aircraft defence during WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Passage in Time
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Big Condo Studios in Liverpool, UK. Located in one of the most haunted cities in the world and believed to be haunted by some very playful spirits. Will they join the team on their investigation tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Poltergeist House
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate a Poltergeist haunting a homeowner who is a wits end. Poltergeistal activity in the home is terrorizing the tenant and paranormal investigators Bex and Sean are about to start the exorcism of this demonic entity away for good.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest.

programme.title: Mississippi Masala
programme.desc: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.desc: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this new 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.

programme.title: White Horse Media
programme.sub-title: God, Satan, Money, & You: Gold Tried in the Fire
programme.desc: MONEY plays a large role in the battle between Jesus and Satan. White Horse Media’s 7-part series explores the peril and power of money, laziness, working, eliminating debt, saving, tithes and offerings, investing vs. gambling, retirement, and earth’s final crisis when “no man can buy or sell save he that has the mark.” Revelation 13:17. Based on Scripture and practical wise principles.

programme.title: 3ABN Worship Hour
programme.sub-title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: In this 3ABN-produced program, John Dinzey addresses some of life’s biggest questions asked by curious minds: Where did I come from? Who am I? Why am I here? How should I live? Where am I going? Have you been taught the theory of evolution? Science has no proven explanation for the existence of life, but promotes various ideas like Darwin’s “primordial soup” theory, the deep-sea hydrothermal vent theory, the RNA world hypothesis, spermism, or chemical evolution. The hopeless idea of the “survival of the fittest” concludes we evolved from animals, and this life is all there is. But the best-selling book of all times presents a loving Creator who offers purpose to live by and the hope of a future beyond this world of sorrow. It matters who you think you are.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

Why is the Lamb of God, Jesus Christ, the only one worthy of opening it? The scenes of each successive phase are relevant to the history of Christ’s church on earth, and the key to understanding this prophecy is found in the Old Testament. What motivates you to study the Bible? Love for the Lord should create our desire to grow in grace and the knowledge of Christ in preparation for His Second Coming.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: The Exodus stands as the most powerful Old Testament display of God's redeeming love—a breathtaking rescue from bondage, filled with miracles and majesty. Yet as glorious as it was, it pointed forward to an even greater deliverance: the cross of Christ. Like Israel in Egypt, we face a hopeless captivity—one we cannot escape on our own. But God stepped in. The same God who split the sea broke the chains of sin through Calvary. Exodus 12 to 15 captures divine power at its peak, but even that pales next to what Jesus accomplished. Our ultimate deliverance was won by His blood, not ours.

programme.title: 3ABN Worship Hour
programme.desc: In this 3ABN-produced program, Jill Morikone presents ten takeaways from the interaction of Jesus and His apostles in Mark, chapter 10. Jesus predicted His betrayal, suffering, and death, but His disciples were unprepared to hear this truth. Although they had walked for three-and-a-half years in ministry with Christ, their selfishness surfaced. James and John asked for glorified positions. Rather than rebuking them, Jesus lovingly invited them to articulate their desires—using the gentlest means possible to gain their attention. Are we, like them, blind to our own selfishness? Do we understand, the heart of true greatness is not just service but self-sacrificing love?

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Stan Smith is a CIA agent painfully dedicated to homeland security. His home life includes doting wife Francine, a ditzy housewife, liberal daughter Hayley and socially awkward teenaged son Steve. Also living in the family's Langley Falls, Va., home are Klaus, a goldfish with the brain of an East German Olympic ski jumper, and Roger, an escaped alien from Area 51, who Stan houses in defiance of his employer due to owing Roger a "life debt." Sounds just like the typical American family, right? Maybe not.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: After having been missing for nearly 20 years, Rick Sanchez suddenly arrives at daughter Beth's doorstep to move in with her and her family. Although Beth welcomes Rick into her home, her husband, Jerry, isn't as happy about the family reunion. Jerry is concerned about Rick, a sociopathic scientist, using the garage as his personal laboratory. In the lab, Rick works on a number of sci-fi gadgets, some of which could be considered dangerous. But that's not all Rick does that concerns Jerry. He also goes on adventures across the universe that often involve his grandchildren, Morty and Summer.

programme.title: The Eric Andre Show
programme.desc: Comic Eric André hosts a late-night show that parodies low-budget public-access programs and brings the talk genre to another level -- not in a good way. It features interviews with celebrities -- some really are, and others are impersonators -- and what producers describe as "extreme real-life weirdos" interspersed with "deranged" man-on-the-street segments and just general chaos in the studio. Working with André is apathetic sidekick Hannibal Buress, who serves as the straight man to the hyperactive host.

programme.title: Aqua Teen Hunger Force Forever
programme.desc: The title of the 11th season of "Aqua Teen Hunger Force" may contain the word "Forever," but it's actually being billed as the final season of the long-running Adult Swim favorite. Meatwad, Master Shake and Frylock provide marriage counseling to unhappy couples across America following a court ruling that makes divorce illegal in the country. The Aqua Teens, who have replaced their bodies with shape-shifting liquid metal, travel through time to try to mend marriages in need of repair. The gang has to prepare unfamiliar foods by following recipes along the way, judged by a cast of celebrity chefs.

His home life includes doting wife Francine, a ditzy housewife, liberal daughter Hayley and socially awkward teenaged son Steve. Also living in the family's Langley Falls, Va., home are Klaus, a goldfish with the brain of an East German Olympic ski jumper, and Roger, an escaped alien from Area 51, who Stan houses in defiance of his employer due to owing Roger a "life debt." Sounds just like the typical American family, right? Maybe not.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: After having been missing for nearly 20 years, Rick Sanchez suddenly arrives at daughter Beth's doorstep to move in with her and her family. Although Beth welcomes Rick into her home, her husband, Jerry, isn't as happy about the family reunion. Jerry is concerned about Rick, a sociopathic scientist, using the garage as his personal laboratory. In the lab, Rick works on a number of sci-fi gadgets, some of which could be considered dangerous. But that's not all Rick does that concerns Jerry. He also goes on adventures across the universe that often involve his grandchildren, Morty and Summer.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

programme.desc: New Year, New Vette. A big fan of Dave's work on Corvettes wants to build his own collection. So, the crew eagerly jumps into modifying every inch of a '58.
